about.text: For over two decades, Elite Residences has been the trusted partner for discerning clients seeking exceptional properties that transcend ordinary luxury living.

To connect visionary clients with exceptional properties that represent not just homes, but legacies. We believe luxury real estate should offer more than prestige—it should provide sanctuary, inspire creativity, and build generational wealth through strategic investment in extraordinary assets.

Our approach combines architectural appreciation with financial acumen, ensuring every property we represent offers both aesthetic excellence and sound investment potential. We maintain relationships with the world's most respected architects, designers, and developers to provide access to truly exclusive opportunities.
The principles that guide every interaction and transaction at Elite Residences.
We maintain absolute confidentiality in all client interactions, ensuring privacy and security throughout the property acquisition process.
Every property in our portfolio meets rigorous standards of architectural quality, location desirability, and investment potential.
We provide transparent advice, honest valuations, and ethical representation, building trust through every transaction.
With specialists in major luxury markets worldwide, we provide insights into local nuances while maintaining global standards.
Our team of luxury property specialists combines decades of experience with passion for exceptional real estate.
With 25+ years in luxury real estate, James founded Elite Residences to create a boutique firm focused exclusively on ultra-premium properties.
Former architect turned luxury property specialist, Victoria brings unique insight into architectural quality and design potential.
Multilingual specialist with expertise in European and Asian luxury markets, facilitating cross-border transactions for international clients.
Two decades of excellence in luxury real estate.
Discover how Elite Residences can help you acquire the exceptional property that matches your vision, lifestyle, and investment objectives.

What is the typical timeline for purchasing a luxury property through Elite Residences?

The timeline for acquiring a luxury property typically ranges from 30 to 90 days, depending on factors such as property availability, due diligence requirements, and financing arrangements. Our concierge team streamlines the entire process, from initial consultation to closing, ensuring a seamless experience. For international clients or complex transactions involving multiple jurisdictions, additional time may be required for legal and regulatory compliance.
Do you offer property viewing services for international clients?

Yes, we specialize in serving international clients and offer comprehensive property viewing services including virtual tours, video consultations, and in-person viewings coordinated with your travel schedule. Our multilingual team can arrange private viewings, provide local market insights, and assist with travel logistics. For clients unable to travel, we offer detailed digital presentations and live virtual tours conducted by our property specialists.
What due diligence services do you provide during the property acquisition process?

Our comprehensive due diligence services include property inspection by certified engineers, title verification, zoning compliance checks, environmental assessments, and historical preservation reviews. We also provide investment analysis, market valuation, and comparative market analysis. For international properties, we coordinate with local legal experts to ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and provide detailed reports on tax implications and ownership structures.
Can you assist with property management after purchase?

Absolutely. We offer premium property management services including maintenance coordination, staff hiring and management (housekeepers, gardeners, security), utility management, and seasonal preparation. Our concierge services also include rental management for investment properties, with comprehensive tenant screening, lease administration, and regular property inspections. We provide detailed monthly reports and 24/7 emergency support for all managed properties.
What makes Elite Residences different from other luxury real estate agencies?

Elite Residences distinguishes itself through our exclusive focus on ultra-premium properties, personalized concierge service, and global network of luxury specialists. We maintain strict confidentiality, offer access to off-market listings, and provide comprehensive investment analysis. Our team includes former architects, interior designers, and financial analysts who offer holistic advisory services. We also provide post-purchase integration services, helping clients with interior design, art acquisition, and lifestyle curation for their new property.

product-details.text: An architectural masterpiece perched on the Malibu cliffs, offering breathtaking ocean views from every room. This contemporary villa features floor-to-ceiling windows, sustainable materials, and seamless indoor-outdoor living spaces. The property includes a private infinity pool, home theater, wine cellar, and direct beach access.

Absolutely stunning property! The ocean views are even more breathtaking in person. The attention to detail in the architecture and finishes is remarkable. Highly recommend scheduling a viewing if you're in the market for a luxury coastal property.

The property is magnificent, though the pricing reflects its premium location. The infinity pool overlooking the Pacific is worth every penny. The only minor drawback is the winding road access, but that's typical for Malibu cliffside properties.
